Terms of use

Practical terms for using this personal portfolio.

Last updated: 28 October 2026

Purpose of the website

This is a personal professional portfolio. Project descriptions show education, internship work, experiments, and prototypes. They do not establish a paid service agreement, professional certification beyond the credentials listed, or a guarantee of fitness for a particular purpose.

Educational and research materials

Security projects are presented for learning and authorized testing. A link to a repository is not permission to test any third-party system. Medical-imaging and emergency-communication projects are research or learning prototypes, not clinical tools or emergency services.

Content and project licences

Original portfolio content belongs to its respective author. Repository code is governed by the licence, if any, in that repository; this website does not grant an additional software licence. Third-party names, logos, and certificate material belong to their respective owners and are shown for identification.

External links and availability

Third-party websites may change independently. Educational prototypes and documentation may be incomplete or become outdated. Review the linked source, its licence, and its limitations before relying on or reusing any project.

Responsible use

Use the site lawfully and avoid disruptive activity, impersonation, or attempts to access information that is not intended to be available. To discuss reuse, collaboration, or a correction, email aliawais4413@gmail.com.
